Hearth Brownie (CV 5)

A small, sturdy household fey with flour-dusted hair, work-worn hands and clothing made from repaired scraps. It values good workmanship, fair hospitality and respect for its chosen home.

Attributes: Brawn -1; Fortitude +1; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +1; Reason +1

HP: 8 · Speed: 5 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Boon · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage
Basic MeleeAgility4/2/1
Wooden spoonAgility3/2/1
ManeuversEffect
Helping handsAid one adjacent ally’s plausible manual task, granting 1 Boon to its next roll before the brownie’s next turn. It has hands and may manipulate ordinary tools, but grants no crafting ability or recipe.
Defend+1 Bane
ReactionsEffect
Opportunity AttackBasic Melee

Details

Wooden spoon

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Small repairs appear overnight in a well-kept home.

Purpose: Keep a household worthy of its care.

Tactics and retreat: Defend a doorway with an oversized spoon, then flee; it prefers work to a fight.

Counterplay and conversation: Offer fair hospitality and respect its boundaries.

Habitat: House; mill · Communication: Common and Fey

Loot: One useful household clue; it does not conjure supplies.

Summoning: Fey 1 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.7ba6c1e7625ff9a1.JournalEntryPage.7a1ca8daee875115]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-hearth-brownie

Category: Fey · Role: Helper · CV: 5

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its minor attack is easier to defend, granting a Boon.
